_comment: The public Masinloc Connect Marketplace.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS RATHER THAN A LIVE QUERY
business_submissions lives in Supabase and predates this repository, so
there is no migration here describing it. More importantly there is no
public read path to it: the table has no anon SELECT policy, and the
columns a visitor may see have never been separated from the ones they may
not. The dictionary has that separation — sambal-tina.js reads
dictionary_entries with an explicit column list against a published-only
policy — and until business_submissions has the same, a browser cannot be
pointed at it without risking owner_name, owner_email and owner_phone.
So this file carries only what a business asked to have published, entered
deliberately rather than queried indiscriminately. Approved-only holds by
construction: a row exists here because somebody put it here after it was
approved, not because a filter was applied correctly.
supabase/MARKETPLACE-LIVE-DATA.md describes what to deploy to move this to
a live feed, and what the page would then read.
WHAT MAY AND MAY NOT APPEAR HERE
The submission form collects two phone numbers and the distinction is the
whole privacy model: contact_number is the number the business wants
customers to call, owner_phone is the owner's own line. Only the first is
public. Likewise owner_name and owner_email are never published, and
neither are reference codes, submission ids, moderation status or
dashboard-interest flags.
Public fields, matching what the edge function writes:
brand_name -> name, store_locations -> location,
short_description -> description, contact_number -> contact,
facebook_page -> facebook
'category' is the one field with no column behind it. It is editorial
classification, not submitted data, which is why it lives here and is kept
to a short list rather than invented per business.
IMAGES
Logos are uploaded to masinloc-business-assets, which the edge function
creates with public:false. A public page cannot load them, and signing a
URL needs the service role. Neither business therefore carries an image,
and the cards are built to look deliberate without one rather than to show
a broken frame. See the runbook for the two ways to change that.

businesses.name: Diwan Coffee
businesses.location: Masinloc Baywalk, Pasalubong Center Stall #8, Masinloc, Zambales
businesses.description: Coffee, non-coffee drinks, freshly made pastries, and signature drinks including the Diwan Alon Latte and the Diwan Alon Biscoff Latte.
businesses._facebook: The submitted Facebook entry has not been verified as a resolvable page URL, so no link is published. Nothing is guessed or tidied into a canonical form.

businesses.name: Adaler's Grazing Delights
businesses.description: Grazing tables and food stations, including kakanin, bread, street food and food offerings for events.
businesses._facebook: A Facebook share URL was submitted. A share URL is not a page URL, and rewriting one into the other would be inventing an address, so no link is published until the page's own URL is confirmed.
